spec.name: Orange Kitchen Loaded Fries
spec.description: A stepped red diner carton overflowing with uneven golden fries, melted cheese ribbons and glossy barbecue sauce. Chunky potato silhouettes and warm, connected pixel shading keep the ingredients readable in inventory.

prompt: Orange SMP Kitchen cohesive premium Minecraft vanilla voxel art. Appetizing recognizable silhouette and deliberate connected pixel shading, material detail and highlights. No plain untextured cubes, random noise, letters or scenery. Use ONE well-mapped 64x64 atlas; per-face UV islands, not repeated generic material tiles. Keep texture palette cohesive: warm golden bread, fresh greens, ivory rice, rich salmon, warm ceramics. Geometry should be carefully stepped and rounded where appropriate, with purposeful tiny details. 20-55 cuboids as appropriate, stay within Java model bounds -16..32. Item ground bottom y0. Strong inventory readability. Create Loaded Fries. Red diner fries carton filled with separate uneven golden potato fries; loaded toppings if specified. Actual recipe ingredients: fries, cheese, bbq sauce. Let the visible appearance reflect these ingredients.
